why: GH issue #4069 fix (card t_42b5f6d8): regenerated to target the calendar's actual top-of-list era, speak-now, now that PR #4062 cleared a speak-now photo (speaknow-inglewood-2023, tags: speak-now, in social/photo-library.json). X sibling, written first: one contradiction (critics doubted a 20-year-old writing entirely alone had real range; Speak Now opened to 1,047,000 copies) + the /?era=speak-now link. Hook shape = the contradiction (per calendar). Sourced entirely from the Vault item 'Speak Now sells over a million copies in a single week' (supabase/seed/content/speak-now.mjs), cited to Billboard + Grammy.com + The Boot: 1,047,000 week-one copies, first album since Lil Wayne's Tha Carter III to cross a million in its opening week. No invented figures. Share hook ('tag whoever doubted her back then') grounded in the real no-co-writers detail cited in the same Vault item. Body trimmed to fit X's 280-weighted-character limit (lib/x-length.mjs) — the fuller framing (nearly doubled Fearless, fourth woman ever to hit a million-copy week) lives in the IG sibling instead.
